name: Partner credentials compared side by side
useWhen: Two or three platform partnerships each need their own proof — depth of certification, scale of delivery, and who it was delivered for — and the point is that all of them are strong.

focal.note: Low on purpose. Twelve claims sharing a canvas cannot each be a display moment; the column structure carries the emphasis instead of any one figure.

replacesNote: Neither logo-wall-v2 (breadth, no depth) nor stats-v5 (depth, no owner) does this job. It is a gap, not a replacement.
